simile.rendering: so that they will not be like barren trees that bear no fruit

plain.verse: And our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others, so that they will not lead useless lives.
plain.rendering: so that they will not lead useless lives

lost.verse: And our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others, so that they will not be seedless.
lost.rendering: so that they will not be seedless

distorted.verse: And our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others, so that they will not be overly productive.
distorted.rendering: so that they will not be overly productive

fig_f4vc.original: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with all of you.

kept_clear.verse: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with all of you.
kept_clear.rendering: those who love us in the faith

simile.verse: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who love us as fellow believers do, bound together in the faith. Grace be with all of you.
simile.rendering: those who love us as fellow believers do, bound together in the faith

plain.verse: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those fellow believers who love us because we share the same faith. Grace be with all of you.
plain.rendering: those fellow believers who love us because we share the same faith

lost.verse: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with all of you.
lost.rendering: those who love us in faith

distorted.verse: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who doubt our faith but love us anyway. Grace be with all of you.
distorted.rendering: those who doubt our faith but love us anyway
